1–2 hours of conversations + collecting the items (can take days) + 3 hours of waiting

The barbarian brothers {npc:Bron} and {npc:Ajax} live near Northport. You teach Ajax that violence is not always the answer, help Bron get rid of an annoying kid and gather materials for gifts between the brothers. In return you receive both addons of the **Barbarian Outfit**: the barbarian wig (Bron) and the axe on the back (Ajax), plus the achievement **Brutal Politeness**.
This outfit stands for brute strength, war cries and bad manners. I heard some barbarians live near Northport. Maybe they can give you addons to match.
**Premium** account (the base Barbarian Outfit is available to all Premium players; this quest only gives the addons).
No minimum level (70+ recommended for hunting the materials).
For the axe addon you must first have the wig (addon 1).
To reach {npc:Marina} (Spools of Yarn): access to Meriana, granted by the *Access to Meriana* mission of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|The Shattered Isles Quest}.
Marina makes 1 for every 10 Spider Silk (100 Spider Silk in total)
axe addon (trade a Giant Sword with A Sweaty Cyclops)
**Barbarian Wig** addon (barbarian wig), given by Bron
**Axe on the back** addon, given by Ajax
Gather the materials **before** you start talking to the NPCs: you save a lot of time.
Use an {item:Obsidian Knife} on the corpses of {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths} and lizards to get a better chance of obtaining {item:Perfect Behemoth Fang|Behemoth Fangs} and {item:Lizard Leather}.
Ajax will set you on fire during the conversation: go with full health.
All of this can be collected before talking to Bron.

The two fortresses are in the Kha'zeel mountains, near **Ankrahmun** (go there by boat). {npc:Haroun} is in {wiki:Ashta'daramai|Ashta'daramai} (blue djinns): go up the ramp into the mountains **north** of Ankrahmun (watch out for the {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}). {npc:Yaman} is in {wiki:Mal'ouquah|Mal'ouquah} (green djinns): follow the passage by the oasis into the mountains. In both, the entrance doors only let through those who are **level 30** or higher. To leave, go back the same way to Ankrahmun.

Take 2 {item:Royal Helmet|Royal Helmets} to the djinns' magic seller — {npc:Haroun} or {npc:Yaman}, depending on the djinn quest you did. Say {key:fighting spirit} and {key:yes}. He extracts a {item:Fighting Spirit}.
With the same djinn ({npc:Haroun} or {npc:Yaman}), trade 4 {item:Warrior Helmet|Warrior Helmets} for a {item:Warrior's Sweat}.
Gather 50 {item:Red Piece of Cloth|Red Pieces of Cloth}. They drop from {creature:Hero|Heroes} and {creature:Barbarian Bloodwalker|Barbarian Bloodwalkers}.

Gather 50 {item:Green Piece of Cloth|Green Pieces of Cloth}. They drop from {creature:Green Djinn|Green Djinns} and {creature:Efreet|Efreets}. Alternatively, buy {item:Green Tunic|Green Tunics} and trade them for green pieces of cloth with {npc:Irmana}, in **Venore** (southeast of the depot, 1 floor up, in the *Dress for Success* warehouse).

Gather 100 {item:Spider Silk} from {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} and {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}. Take it to the mermaid {npc:Marina}, in **Meriana**, north of Sabrehaven: in Liberty Bay, talk to {npc:Captain Waverider} ({key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes}; 50 gp). She makes 1 {item:Spool of Yarn} for every 10 Spider Silk. You need 10. To get back to Liberty Bay, talk to {npc:Sebastian}, south of Sabrehaven: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (50 gp).

Go to {npc:Bron}'s hut, in the Fields of Glory, near Northport: from **Carlin** walk **northeast**. Say {key:hi}, {key:outfit} and then {key:violence}. He wants his brother to learn that violence is not always the answer. Accept with {key:yes} and confirm again with {key:yes}.

Go to {npc:Ajax}, **west** of Northport (a little northeast of Bron's hut). Say {key:hi} and then {key:MINE}. He gets furious and tells you to go away. Answer {key:no} until he asks *"HOW I MAKE YOU GO??"*; then say {key:say please} and {key:yes}.
Ajax sets you on fire during the conversation. Go with full health.
Do not talk to Ajax **at all** for **1 real-time hour**. Then come back and say {key:hi}: he admits his brother is right.
If you talk to him before the hour is up, the counter restarts and you have to wait another hour from that moment.

Go back to {npc:Bron} and say {key:fist not always good}. He is pleased, but there is a person near the house who bothers him. Say {key:person} and {key:yes}: he wants you to ask Ajax about {npc:Gelagos}.
3. The Fighting Spirit and the wig
Say to {npc:Ajax}: {key:hi}, {key:Gelagos} and {key:fighting spirit}. He says his brother needs magical fighting spirit, from a djinn.
Give the Fighting Spirit to Bron
With the {item:Fighting Spirit} (see section 1), go to {npc:Bron} and say {key:hi} and {key:fighting spirit}. He is possessed by rage. Say {key:bye}.
Talk to {npc:Bron} again ({key:hi}) and answer {key:yes} three times. He wants to make a shirt for Ajax and needs 50 Red Cloth, 50 Green Cloth, 10 Spools of Yarn and a Warrior's Sweat.
Say {key:red piece of cloth} and {key:yes} to hand in the 50 red cloths and the 50 green ones.
Say {key:spider silk} and {key:yes} to hand in the 10 {item:Spool of Yarn|Spools of Yarn}.
Hand in the Warrior's Sweat and get the wig
Say {key:warrior's sweat}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again to accept the gift. You receive the **barbarian wig**.
You can only do this part after you have the wig.

Gather: 100 {item:Iron Ore} (from all types of {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves}, {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}, {creature:Worker Golem|Worker Golems}, {creature:War Golem|War Golems} and {creature:Damaged Worker Golem|Damaged Worker Golems}); 1 {item:Huge Chunk of Crude Iron} (take a {item:Giant Sword} to {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops}); 50 {item:Perfect Behemoth Fang|Behemoth Fangs} (from {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths}); and 50 {item:Lizard Leather} (from all kinds of lizards).

Use an {item:Obsidian Knife} on the corpses of Behemoths and lizards to get a better chance of obtaining fangs and leather. {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} lives in **Ab'Dendriel**, on the 4th floor of a tower to the **northeast** of the depot: enter the small {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} cave under the wheat field east of the depot, cross it to the tower and climb to the top floor; to leave, go back the same way. He only trades after you complete {wiki:The Sweaty Cyclops Quest|The Sweaty Cyclops Quest}.
A Sweaty Cyclops (4th floor of the tower, Ab'Dendriel)
Hand everything over in this order, answering {key:yes} to each: {key:iron ore}, {key:crude iron}, {key:behemoth fang}, {key:lizard leather}.
Wait 2 hours and collect the axe
Wait **2 hours** and then say to {npc:Ajax}: {key:hi}, {key:axe}. You receive the axe addon and the achievement **Brutal Politeness**.
The base Barbarian Outfit is already available to all Premium players; this quest only gives the addons.
